name: push-known-size
axis: building a list whose final size is a compile-time constant with push (sunpa SP-036's 4x4 matrix product)
n: N=1000000 products, each building a fresh 16-element list
nPython: N=50000 products (20x fewer; multiply Python's wall time by 20 to compare). The product converges, so the checksum is the same
notes: main.vl pushes into `const o: f64[] = []` inside `for c in 0 until 4 { for r in 0 until 4 { ... } }`; opt.vl writes `filled(16, 0.0)` by index. D3623 reserves the list at 16 and appends through locals, so the two differ only by the per-push count test. The Rust result is a `[f64; 16]` by value, behind #[inline(never)].
